text:
Sunset's just passed and the sky's cooperating, clear skies easing into partly cloudy overnight with the low settling around 65. If you're still out on the waterfront, south winds are down to 10 to 15 knots and dropping through the evening, waves staying a foot or less, so it's a calm one to close out the day. Water's still sitting at a swimmable 74.

Tomorrow brings scattered showers and storms, but not until afternoon, and even then NWS and the models agree it's a lighter touch, 30 percent chance with less than a tenth of an inch. Morning through early afternoon looks mostly sunny with a high near 86. One thing to watch: ozone runs moderate Monday, so if you've got sensitive lungs, don't overdo the midday exertion outside. Otherwise, get your outdoor plans in before early afternoon, then keep half an eye on the sky heading into evening.
